# czc-v2026.10.23.2 (0.2.17.25)

The astra health dots are back on GPT accounts in the admin account list.
Each OpenAI OAuth / setup-token / API-key row shows `astra` and its last ten
Tibo probe results again (green healthy, red degraded).

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.23.1

### Astra health dots restored

- czc-v2026.10.22.1 (`6fc953138`, "stop synthetic traffic the Codex CLI never
  sends") added `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled` with a default of
  `false`. Production's `config.yaml` does not set the key, so the Tibo
  probes stopped and the account list stopped returning
  `codex_turn_tickets`. The frontend sparkline had no data and disappeared.
  The last probe result stored in the database is from
  2026-10-22 02:29 UTC.
- The default is `true` again. Each eligible account (active, schedulable,
  not rate-limited) is probed about every 10 minutes (±5). With the current
  account pool that is roughly 90 probe requests per hour across all
  accounts.
- `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled: false` still turns the probes off; the
  dots then disappear. `deploy/config.example.yaml` now lists the key.

### Persisted dots shown before the first new probe

- The admin view only read in-memory probe state. After a restart, accounts
  that are skipped (rate-limited, paused, error) or not probed yet showed ten
  grey dots, although their last results were stored on the account.
- The view now falls back to the stored `recent_samples` when this process
  has none for the account. It only reads; it does not start probes or change
  routing state.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.25`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no required configuration change.

- Right after the restart, rows show the results stored before probing
  stopped (up to a day old; each dot's tooltip has its time). New results are
  appended from about 5-15 minutes after start.
- Accounts 23072, 23073, 23136 and 23139 have a stored verdict but no stored
  samples; their dots stay grey until their first new probe.
- An account that has never been probed makes its first request wait up to
  8 seconds for a probe (same as before czc-v2026.10.22.1). Today only
  23073 and 23155 have never been probed; the wait does not repeat after the
  first sample is stored.

## Compatibility

- Deployments that relied on the czc-v2026.10.22.1 default to keep Tibo
  probes off must now set `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled: false`
  explicitly.
- Routing is unchanged: requests always go over HTTP, and
  `scheduler_prefer_healthy_route` stays `false` by default. The verdict only
  sets the `route_degraded` usage flag and the admin dots.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.23.1`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.23.2-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. To keep this binary but stop the
probes, set `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled: false` and restart.
